_about: ILC hyperparameters for the synthetic + PyBullet benchmark. Track-specific overrides go in the track's own config JSON under `ilc_global_overrides` and `ilc_section_overrides`. NEVER hard-code values that vary per-course in scripts/benchmark.py — they belong here or in the track config.

low._about: Smooth / low-curvature segments. Conservative — small alpha, tight max_corr, low cutoff (more smoothing), zero velocity scaling.

high._about: High-curvature segments (e.g. helix climbs, S-turn inflections). Aggressive — larger alpha, wider max_corr, mid velocity scaling.

partition._about: How derive_section_boundaries splits a trajectory into low/high-class sections.
